description: Black-and-white photograph of a young Donald Trump in a dark suit holding a large American flag on a pole atop an unfinished skyscraper rooftop, with the Manhattan skyline stretching out below. Consistent with widely published early-1980s press photos of Trump during the construction/topping-out of Trump Tower in New York City. No captions or annotations are present.
flags: Location/date inferred from resemblance to known 1980s Trump Tower construction photos, not shown in the image itself

description: Collage of roughly 16 cropped news and opinion headlines from various outlets (Gawker, The New York Times, Salon, Cracked, Newsweek, CBC, The Independent, Good Men Project and others) concerning pedophilia, framed as sympathetic or destigmatizing. The original filename "Normalize_Why_.png" indicates the compilation is presented as evidence of media normalizing pedophilia; the collage itself asserts this only by juxtaposition. Headlines are real-looking clippings but are presented without dates or full context.
text: GAWKER. Born This Way: Sympathy and Science for Those Who Want to Have Sex with Children. My father, the 'respectable' paedophile. Video Shows Toddlers Understand Consent. The New York Times. The Opinion Pages. Pedophilia: A Disorder, Not a Crime. SALON. I'm a pedophile, but not a monster. I'm attracted to children but unwilling to act on it. Before judging me harshly, would you be willing to listen?. Paedophilia a 'sexual orientation - like being straight or gay'. A paedophile has the 'same ingrained attraction that a heterosexual female may feel towards a male', psychologist says. I'm a pedophile, you're the monsters: My week inside the vile right-wing hate machine. A Pedophile Opens Up About Being Targeted by Vigilantes. Can a child legally consent to sex?. CRACKED. 5 Ways We Misunderstand Pedophilia (That Makes it Worse). THE BLOG. This Is How You Teach Kids About Consent. By The Good Men Project. Voices. Not all paedophiles are bad people - we need to have a sense of proportion. In my studies of the activist group Paedophile Information Exchange, many members admitted sexual feelings for children which they had been able to turn to social good. Is pedophilia a sexual orientation?. CBC doc reveals the struggle of the world's most-loathed population: pedophiles. One in 100 men are born pedophilic. So rather than stigmatizing them, why not help before they hurt somebody?. Newsweek. IN THE MAGAZINE. ANALYSIS. WHY IS THE ALT-RIGHT OBSESSED WITH PEDOPHILIA?. BY ALEXANDER NAZARYAN ON 11/7/17 AT 11:57 AM. INDY/PULSE. PAEDOPHILIA IS 'FATE, NOT A CHOICE', LEADING SCIENTIST CLAIMS.
flags: Compilation implies coordinated media normalization of pedophilia by juxtaposing headlines stripped of dates and context; the implication is the compiler’s claim, not established fact

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4110 (board post No. 9038385, tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, ID 3e3689), dated May 5 2020. The drop links an NBC News article about the FBI agreeing with the CIA assessment that Russia wanted to help Trump, then asks whether the assessment was a [Brennan] & [Comey] effort with a [Clapper assist][hard-push], and links two DOJ criminal resource manual pages (18 USC 371 conspiracy to defraud the US; "knowingly and willfully") and the US Code Title 18 Chapter 115. The drop insinuates the intelligence assessment was a criminal conspiracy; this is the drop’s claim.

description: Edited screen capture of Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein speaking into a microphone at what appears to be a Senate hearing, with a woman seated behind him enlarged inside a red circle and a large red question mark overlaid at left. The filename "Barsoomian.jpg" indicates the image circulates with the claim that the circled woman is Lisa Barsoomian, Rosenstein’s wife, an attorney targeted by viral conspiracy claims; the image itself contains no caption confirming her identity.
